name: finance-local
description: Bridges Claude to free financial data sources via a local Node MCP server: TWSE (台灣加權指數／三大法人／個股), FRED (美國利率／油價／DXY), Stooq (US/global indices proxies + equities), MOPS OpenAPI (台股月營收), and a local ETF look-through calculator for TSMC exposure & leverage ratio. Bypasses sandbox network restrictions by running on the user's Mac.
